support.prompt: Can you add a feature for recurring quotes every month?
support.response: Currently, TEKANGO does not have a feature for creating recurring quotes. You can create and send quotes manually, but automated recurring quotes are not available at this time. If you have any other feature requests or questions, feel free to ask!
